title: UAAP: Pido Jarencio fires back at haters with UST win over La Salle
summary: MANILA, Philippines—Coach Pido Jarencio was all smiles and banter following University of Santo Tomas’ victory over defending champion La Salle in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Coach Pido Jarencio was all smiles and banter following University of Santo Tomas’ victory over defending champion La Salle in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Wednesday. Jarencio, who is in his second tour of duty as UST’s coach after leading the school to a championship in 2006, poked fun at his haters and naysayers after steering the Growling Tigers to their first win.
